hukhong.story.doc.a1: "The waning night will be whole again." Those who feel a piece of their life is missing, come claim it from the Night Hall. Bring sincerity, not your true name.
hukhong.story.doc.a2: Directive to the Shadow Line: unlock the Hắc Thạch Pass city defense formation before the moon cycle. Let no one see your true face.
hukhong.story.doc.a3: Secret report: Hống still believes he protects his tribe. Do not wake him. He does not know he is only a rebuilt shadow.
hukhong.story.doc.a4: Tribute ledger: the villages that delivered offerings to Hống over three moon seasons. The Void must feed, and it feeds regularly.
hukhong.story.doc.a5: A map of Viêm Sơn with a red circle around a cave amid the lava flows. A note in the margin: "Let no one go beyond this place."
hukhong.story.doc.a6: Letter in Dạ Khuyết's hand: "The Earth Gate needs only one person holding it in the right place. Bring that person, and I will handle the rest. The waning night will be whole again."
hukhong.story.doc.b1: Hymn of the Void Saint: "No more difference, no more pain." The infected chant this each night until they forget they were ever different from anyone.
hukhong.story.doc.b2: A list of "like-minded friends" inside the Radiant Daoist Palace, with their watch hours and the gates they guard. Two names have been crossed out.
hukhong.story.doc.b3: A diary of an Apostle: "The Saintess takes no side; she only wants everyone free of pain. Sometimes I wonder whom I am really following."
hukhong.story.doc.b4: Notes on the original: Bạch Từ Âm died healing the infected, not fighting. The one who stands in the temple now keeps only her compassion.
hukhong.story.doc.b5: The plan: use Dạ Khuyết as the Void's interpreter. The Void does not understand human speech, but it understands a god's fear of growing old.
hukhong.story.doc.b6: Dạ Khuyết's letter: "Ask the Saintess about the door. She will tell the truth." Beneath the signature, a crescent moon cut with one extra stroke.
hukhong.chg.lair.revealed: The lair of %s lies around X=%s Z=%s.
hukhong.chg.line.1: "This is the land of my kin. Whoever steps further is an enemy of blood and flesh."
hukhong.chg.line.2: "Have you never wished for someone's pain to end?"
hukhong.chg.line.3: "A sword asks no name. Neither should you speak yours."
hukhong.chg.line.4: "I smell on you the scent of one about to seek a god and demand answers."
hukhong.chg.fall.1: "You are stronger than I... you will see in time."
hukhong.chg.fall.2: "If pain is real, why do you still keep it?"
hukhong.chg.fall.3: "I dreamed always of a sword no one has drawn."
hukhong.chg.fall.4: "Tell him: the waning night never becomes full."

hukhong.story.chap.5.obj: Hunt the Executors: follow the lair clues (Thach Hong, Bach Tu Am)
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.idle.p1: The road is long. I will keep watching the news from the cities.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p1: You saw it too? The man outside the gate... his name faded like mist.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p2: I am Mo Dao, a Dao cultivator. The Void is eating this world, one name at a time.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1.p3: Walk with me? At least until you are strong enough to stand alone.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1_lore.p1: Something beyond the Heavenly Dao: nameless, formless, only hungry. A thousand years ago it tore the Great Rift.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch1_end.p1: Good. Enter the Dao and reach level 10. At Hac Thach Pass there is one of rare talent, worth meeting.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_wait.p1: You have grown stronger. When a lair clue emerges (level 50), come find me.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p1: You traced a lair... Then I cannot hide it any longer.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p2: My parents were Emissaries of Da Khuyet. I grew up in the Night Hall as a child.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4.p3: I have opposed them for a long time. Do you still trust me?
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_trust.p1: Thank you. The lairs of Thach Hong and Bach Tu Am lie within the clues you gathered. Follow them.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch4_doubt.p1: I understand. Let deeds prove it. Follow the Executor lair clues.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.early.p1: You are too weak. Return at level 10 once you have met Mo Dao.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.p1: Hang Chieu. Remember the name; soon all the world will.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.p2: The Void-touched I cut down had sect tokens on them. The enemy is not outside; it is inside our own house.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.c1: Let us investigate together. I will not lose to you.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2.c2: I will walk my own road.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.ch2_end.p1: Hunt the Emissaries in the corrupted lands; they drop Van Kien. I hear the old archivist in Co Tien City knows more than he lets on.
hukhong.dlg.hang_chieu.idle.p1: Do not let me leave you far behind.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.early.p1: A novice is not ready to hear old tales. Reach level 30 and bring two Van Kien.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p1: Van Kien... you have read them. Then I will say it: a god opened the Night Gate with his own hand.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p2: The four Executors are not the four Great Cultivators. They are copies the Void simulated; the originals died long ago.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.p3: Gather three Van Kien of one chain and a lair will reveal itself. Take this pill.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3.c1: Thank you. I will follow the trail.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.ch3_end.p1: At level 50, go back and tell Mo Dao what you found. She has something to say.
hukhong.dlg.hua_co.idle.p1: So many books, so little time. Go.

hukhong.endgame.locked: The gate does not answer. Defeat all four Executors and reach level %s.
hukhong.endgame.nodim: The Primordial Void could not be loaded (dimension missing).
hukhong.endgame.enter: You step into the Primordial Void. No up or down remain, only drifting islands.
hukhong.endgame.boss.line.4: "Everything you hold will change. I only want it to stop changing."
hukhong.endgame.boss.slain: The Open Circle shatters and silently swallows the last echo. Primordial Oblivion has fallen.
hukhong.endgame.dakhuyet.appear.1: Da Khuyet: "I am only the translator. Do not look at me like that."
hukhong.endgame.dakhuyet.appear.2: Da Khuyet: "The waning night will be whole again... if only you would stop resisting."
hukhong.endgame.dakhuyet.fall: Da Khuyet falls; the crescent on his brow fades.
hukhong.endgame.dakhuyet.flee: If Da Khuyet still lived, he slipped into a crack in the Void as the primal will unravelled.
hukhong.endgame.choice.title: The Final Choice
hukhong.endgame.choice.once: Chosen once; engraved on your own Monument of Deeds.
hukhong.endgame.choice.seal.desc: Assemble the Heaven Gate and close the Void. The world finds peace, but the seal needs guarding. World Tier II: a bright world of Ancient Spirits and Fallen Gods.
hukhong.endgame.choice.absorb.desc: Swallow the Void into your divine core. You become the center of power, but alone. World Tier II: a purple-black world of tamed Void Spawn.
hukhong.endgame.tier2: World Tier II unlocked: mobs are stronger, rewards are greater.
hukhong.endgame.return.seal: The gate closes behind you. The world is quiet, yet something feels unfinished.
hukhong.endgame.return.absorb: The Void rests within you. People look at you with fear.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.title: SEAL
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.1: The four Shards ignite and join into the Heaven Gate.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.2: The Night Gate closes. Whatever remains inside stays there.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.seal.3: The first dawn in three hundred years.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.title: ABSORB
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.1: The Void flows back into you, silent as water into sand.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.2: The Night Gate opens within your chest. No one speaks to you anymore.
hukhong.endgame.cutscene.absorb.3: You are everything. And you are alone.
hukhong.endgame.credits.title: HU KHONG CULTIVATION
hukhong.endgame.credits.4: The Four Executors: Thach Hong, Bach Tu Am, Lang Uyen, Co Vo Tan
hukhong.endgame.credits.6: The primal will of the Void: Primordial Oblivion
hukhong.endgame.credits.9: Thank you to every player who walked this road to its end
hukhong.endgame.credits.11: The waning night never turns whole
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5_wait.p1: Four Executors remain, and the road to level ninety-nine. Then I will show you the door.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p1: The four Executors have fallen and you stand here at level ninety-nine. I never thought I would see this day.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p2: A gate has opened near where you stood. Beyond lies the Primordial Void, where Primordial Oblivion dwells.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.p3: The Void is not evil; it only wants everything to stop being different. And Da Khuyet will be there, standing beside it.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5.msg: Open the Gate of the Primordial Void and defeat Primordial Oblivion.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch5_end.p1: Go. Whatever you choose, I will be here.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_seal.p1: You sealed it. I can see the light returning to the rooftops.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_seal.p2: But a seal needs a guardian. And I have a feeling this is not finished.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_absorb.p1: You swallowed it. Everyone out there looks at you, and they are afraid.
hukhong.dlg.mo_dao.ch6_absorb.p2: I am not afraid. But I will not pretend you are the same as before.
